description: Mechanical contractor here. On a three-storey, twelve-unit wood-frame apartment with a building area of 480 m2 we have supply ducts that pass through the rated corridor walls. There's no room above the ceiling for damper access panels, so we'd like to skip the fire dampers and instead use 26 gauge steel duct sealed with a listed firestop at each wall. The ducts are about 150 by 250 mm and serve the suites' heat recovery ventilators.
known_facts: three storeys, twelve dwelling units, wood frame
steel duct with listed firestop instead
ducts about 150 x 250 mm serving HRVs
